definitions.full: H6382. pele מֶּ֫לֶא noun masculine wonder (Late Hebrew id. ; as unusual, extraordinary ); — ׳פ Exod 15:11 6 t.; suffix מִּלְאֲךָ Psa 89:6 ; מִּלְאֶ֑ךָ 77:12 ; 88:13 , plural מְּלָאִים Lam 1:9 ; feminine plural מְּלָאוֺת Psa 119:129 ; Dan 12:6 ; — 1 wonder: extraordinary, hard to be understood, God's dealings with His people Isa 29:14 ; the testimonies of the Law Psa 119:129 ; יוֺעֵץ מֶּלֶא Isa 9:5 marvel of a counsellor (Baer מֵּלֶא ), wonderful counsellor (of Messianic king); plural as adverb accusative פ ׳וַתֵּרֶד Lam 1:9 she (Jerusalem) hath come down marvelously . 2 wonder: of God's acts of judgment and redemption Psa 77:12 ; 88:13 ; 89:6 ; פ ׳עשׂה Exod 15:11 ; Isa 25:1 ; Psa 77:15 ; 78:12 ; 88:11 ; of extraordinary trials הפ ׳קֵץ Dan 12:6 .

occurrences.englishText: Who is like you, Yahweh, among the gods?
I will also meditate on all your work,
You have redeemed your people with your arm,
He did marvelous things in the sight of their fathers,
Is your loving kindness declared in the grave?
But to you, Yahweh, I have cried.
For who in the skies can be compared to Yahweh?
For all the armor of the armed man in the noisy battle, and the garments rolled in blood, will be for burning, fuel for the fire.
Yahweh, you are my God. I will exalt you! I will praise your name, for you have done wonderful things, things planned long ago, in complete faithfulness and truth.

therefore, behold, I will proceed to do a marvelous work among this people, even a marvelous work and a wonder; and the wisdom of their wise men will perish, and the understanding of their prudent men will be hidden.”
Her filthiness was in her skirts.
One said to the man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, “How long will it be to the end of these wonders?”
